digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership enforcement and legacy facade removal
propositions: An AST-based ownership gate must reject direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ access, load_config aliases, backend property reload) outside approved composition seams and fail on newly declared names lacking a registered owner.

The ownership registry and configuration precedence/lifecycle must be generated from authoritative schema and adapter registries; generated docs (config.md, security.md) must stay synchronized and cover precedence, restart behavior, observability, subprocess limits, and provider-neutral deltas.
Both the ownership-direction AST gate and the existing field-consumption gate must execute in `make lint` and CI; parity tests must fail if either invocation is silently omitted.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient paths, and exception entries must be removed only after focused behavioral suites, bounded live canaries (provider, AWS review-bot, reconciler), and all structural gates pass with no unauthorized fallback or credential leakage.
